$comment: What an Arcade admin enters under Dashboard > MCP servers > Add Server > Remote MCP. Field names follow docs.arcade.dev/guides/mcp-gateways/add-remote-servers (2026-10-20). Checked by test/arcade-integration.test.mjs.
name: DC Hub
description: DC Hub: live, dated data on data centers and their power for AI agents. Data center facilities and operators, market power verdicts (DCPI BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID), live ISO grid data, interconnection queues, energy and gas prices, fiber and subsea routes, site selection and site risk, M&A, and available colocation and powered-land capacity. Every result carries cite_as and as_of.

none.note: Keyless. Every tool answers; keyless answers are previews and a gated result carries human_url and human_message. Keyless calls are counted per source IP, and every user of an Arcade gateway shares Arcade egress IPs, so use a key for anything beyond evaluation.

api_key.note: One key per Arcade project (the header applies to every user of the gateway). A free key comes from claim_free_key on dchub.cloud/mcp; a partner key from partnerships@dchub.cloud.

oauth.note: Optional, per end user: register this URI instead of /mcp and Arcade runs the OAuth flow on each user's first call. Not yet exercised end to end from Arcade.

lean.note: Recommended default for a gateway: one front door plus the single-fact tools agents call most.

read_only.note: Every read-only tool: the full catalog minus key, email, alert, shortlist, capacity-terms and other write tools. Same set as the /mcp/claude directory profile.

core_endpoint.note: Alternative: register https://dchub.cloud/mcp/core as a second server (id dchub-core). Ten composite read-only tools with a uniform as_of/sources/access envelope.
